reviews.title: Decent Micro ATX board
reviews.comment:
I was building a compact PC to use as a Plex server and needed a Micro ATX board. The ASRock B860M X DDR5 met my needs.
It fit well in my Cooler Master Q300L V2 case and has most of the basics. Since I had an existing PCIe WiFi card, I opted for the non-WiFi version. The SSD slot is placed right below the CPU and is easy to install, requiring just two screws. It only has one SSD slot (the second M.2 slot is for a WiFi card), which can be limiting depending on your storage needs. While it only has 2 RAM slots, it does support up to 128 GB of RAM.
The UEFI bios is easy to navigate and has all the advanced features you would expect - processor tuning (power, etc.), fan control, etc.
All in all this is a decent board for small builds.
reviews.author: Sean G.
